blocks.content: Course: Learn React Zustand: The Smarter Way to Handle Data
This course was never just about Zustand. It was about learning how to think about state in a React app.

items: When to keep state local and when to make it global
How to organize a store as your app grows
How to handle async data, loading states, and errors
How to compute derived state with selectors
How to persist UI preferences across page refreshes

blocks.content: These skills carry over to every React project you build from here. Whether you use Zustand, another library, or the Context API — the thinking is the same.
Next, you will see where to go from here. Click Next Lesson to continue.
